title: From Miami: Everglades Nature and Wildlife Tram Adventure
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the wonders of the Everglades on this engaging tram adventure. Travel from Miami to Shark Valley in a comfortable van, then enjoy a guided tram tour along a 15-mile loop, led by an expert naturalist. Spot alligators, wading birds, and turtles while learning about the unique ecosystem and conservation efforts. The tour includes a stop at the Shark Valley Observation Tower for stunning views and a chance to relax with fresh fruit and beverages.

- Round-trip transportation from Miami for convenience
- Guided tram tour with a professional naturalist for insider knowledge
- Admission to Everglades National Park included
- Snacks and unlimited soft drinks provided during the tour
